Construct a SLURM Array Job Specification

Source: R/job.R
slurm_job_spec.Rd

Bundles a worker function, argument list, resource plan, packages, globals, and optional Apptainer/module metadata into a validated slurmpilot_job_spec ready for slurm_submit().

Usage

slurm_job_spec(
  fun,
  args_list,
  resources = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  packages = character(),
  globals = list(),
  seed = NULL,
  continue_on_error = FALSE,
  container_sif = NULL,
  container_binds = character(),
  modules = character(),
  env_vars = list(),
  dependency = NULL,
  warn_bundle_mb = 50
)

Arguments

fun

Function accepting a single element of args_list (fun(arg)).

args_list

Non-empty list (or vector coercible to list) of task inputs.

resources

Optional slurmpilot_resources object from estimate_resources() or resource_spec(). If NULL, creates a sensible default resource_spec(n_tasks = length(args_list)).

name

Optional job name (sanitized for SLURM --job-name).

packages

Character vector of packages to load on workers.

globals

Named list of helper objects/functions bound to fun.

seed

Optional integer base seed (task i uses seed + i).

continue_on_error

Logical; if TRUE, writes partial chunk checkpoints even if individual tasks error. Default FALSE.

container_sif

Optional path to Apptainer .sif image.

container_binds

Optional character vector of Apptainer --bind mounts.

modules

Optional character vector of HPC modules to load.

env_vars

Optional named list/vector of extra environment variables.

dependency

Optional SLURM --dependency string (e.g. "afterok:12345").

warn_bundle_mb

Optional numeric size threshold in MB (default 50); emits a diagnostic warning if the serialized payload (fun, closure, args_list, globals) exceeds this threshold. Set Inf to disable.

Value

An S3 object of class "slurmpilot_job_spec".

See also

slurm_submit(), estimate_resources(), inspect_job_globals(), use_rcapsule_container()

Examples

spec <- slurm_job_spec(
  fun = function(x) x^2,
  args_list = as.list(1:10),
  resources = resource_spec(n_tasks = 10, chunk_size = 5),
  name = "squares"
)
print(spec)
#> 
#> ── slurmpilot Job Specification (squares) 
#> • Tasks: 10 across 2 chunks (5 tasks/chunk)
#> • Resources: --array=1-2 --cpus-per-task=1 --mem=1G --time=00:15:00
#> • Packages: none
